name: n8n-hubspot-company-domain-enrichment-mapper
description: Asynchronous n8n enrichment router: extracts root domains from new HubSpot companies, queries a company metadata API (industry, employee count, tech stack) and maps the results back onto HubSpot company properties.
author: DH Robin (dhRobin Systems)

scripts.lint: node --check config.validator.js && node --check workflow.harness.js && node --check scripts/build-workflow.js && node --check src/domain.js && node --check src/mapper.js && node --check src/router.js && node --check test/domain.test.js && node --check test/mapper.test.js && node --check test/config.test.js && node --check test/workflow.test.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('workflow.json','utf8'))"
